meshSpace: Y up, meters, sibling of the rendered bowl model
geometry: Extract 77 connected food pellet components and the bulk food component from the canister. Pack two fixed layers of pellets into a circular bowl footprint; retain pellet shapes and UVs. Exclude canister shell, handle and hardware.
fill: Translate the entire shared mesh in local Y only. Scale, vertices and normals remain constant; zero fill hides the renderer.
clipping: 128x128 RFloat highest upward inner bowl surface; .42 m span, .201 m maximum interior radius. The fixed bowl matrix clips submerged food in forward, shadow, depth and depth-normal passes.
